established_this_checkpoint: this lane violated clause 4 of its own estimand contract by comparing c across operating points and reading the movement as coupling; an external review caught it and the interpretation is withdrawn

the permitted quantity, the absolute excess joint miss rate, reverses the reading: the burden peaks at intermediate capture near 0.898 at 66.2 to 139.5 per thousand and falls to 38.8 to 87.4 at the highest capture

the novelty claim is corrected: label free reliability and dependence assessment has direct prior art in Berk et al 2019 and Jaffe et al 2015, and only a narrow Definition 32 sign and bound may be new

negative result: the failure is diffuse. The worst 5 percent of the population carries 7 to 14 percent of the excess and the worst quarter carries 31 to 45, so there is no small region to exclude and the blind spot atlas idea is refuted
suggestive only, two pairs per cell: changing architecture on the same sensor lands inside the same architecture coupling range while changing the sensor moves out of it
next_falsifier: A crossed design with several pairs per cell, varying sensor modality, training corpus, architecture and pretraining independently, is what turns the architecture observation into evidence. Until then the ordering may be sensor physics or construction lineage and this lane cannot separate them.
